title: ux-paths path inventory
description: <auditDir>/paths.json. One entry per user job, hand maintained. The id prefix must be the lane's asBuiltPrefix; loadPaths checks that, plus unique ids and a known lane.

job.description: One sentence: the job the person finishes on this path.

refs.description: Client document references for this path. May be empty.

specs.description: Repo-relative e2e specs that cover this path. May be empty.

group.description: Free grouping label used to order the audit.
